problem_type: Raw alias, semantic capability and model presentation boundaries must preserve their respective shapes
symptom: Timeline read returns capability_input_invalid without revision; queued canvas reads fail with Expected object received string.
direct_cause: Desktop timeline glue passes bound operation back into strict alias args; Pi canvas transport formats canonical result before lane validates it.
class_root: Read transport assembly did not preserve raw/semantic/presentation contracts at adjacent boundaries.
affected_population: All live or captured Pi canvas reads
entry_points: Document read aliases and deferred surface reads
internal_only_reason: No external protocol, dependency or schema changes; the shape mismatch is entirely between existing internal adapters.
invariants: Only the alias parser binds operation into semantic input.
Verified read adapters return canonical domain data; the model outlet owns compact presentation.
Surface and strict input validation remain fail-closed.
generality_proof: Shared timeline family glue handles both read aliases; both Pi canvas adapters preserve the executor canonical object and lane uses the existing compact formatter. Document and deferred adapters already follow these contracts.

prevention.invariant: Read assembly preserves raw alias and canonical result contracts before model presentation.
